configFlags.description: Storefront config.json public flags injected for this package (e.g., commerce-b2b-enabled). Merged into config.public.default by the config generator — data-driven, mirrors addon configFlags.

requiresMesh.description:
API Mesh requirement for this package.
- true: mesh auto-included, no user choice
- false (default): no mesh, no user choice
- 'optional': mesh toggle shown, user decides

datapack.description: The datapack this demo expects (D26). The Sample Data step pre-selects it and says why; the SC can change it. Optional: shipped brands may leave the choice open.

integrations.description: Integrations this demo depends on (D29). The Integrations area starts with them added; the SC can remove any. The same field a shared-demo description file carries, so the catalog and the slice cannot drift.

description.description: Optional here and below; `DemoPackage` requires them because a shipped brand always has a card and store codes.

configDefaults.description: Default configuration values (env var name to value) - embedded brand data

builtWith.description: What the storefront was built from, written by "Save as demo package" (EDS-13f decision 2). Present means a Demo Builder storefront: starting a project from it applies the ledger's fixes where they fit. Absent (a colleague who did not build with Demo Builder, or a version-1 file) behaves as before.

SharedDemoDescription.description:
The storefront slice: what a demo package says about a demo, in any of its three homes. Derived from `DemoPackage` so the catalog cannot drift from it.

`blockLibraries` is file-only: our catalog expresses the same fact the other way round (`block-libraries.json`'s `defaultForPackages`), which a colleague's repo cannot edit. It names shipped library ids to pre-tick.

`contentSource` is normally read from the repo's `fstab.yaml`; the file may state it to add an `indexPath`, or to override.

DatapackReference.description: A datapack a demo expects (D26). `version` absent means the catalog's default rule.

DemoIntegrations.description: Integrations a demo depends on (D29): catalog ids, and custom apps by link.

CustomIntegrationSource.description: A custom App Builder app by GitHub coordinates, the `appBuilderComponentSources` shape.

indexPath.description: Where the site lists its pages. Required: whoever names a content site names its index path (the catalog, the project row, a description file); only the Add a demo package probe looks one up, for a repository that names no site of its own, and records what it found. `contentIndex.ts` builds the URL every reader uses.

package.description: The shipped package id, when the storefront was a shipped brand.

template.description: The template the storefront was generated from and pinned to.

lkg.description: The last-known-good commit of that template the storefront was pinned to.

codePatchSource.description: The patch ledger the storefront was patched from.

codePatches.description: The ledger's patch ids the storefront carries.

boilerplate.description: Its `package.json` name and version when it was saved.

extension.description: The Demo Builder version that saved it.

SharedDemoBuiltWith.description: A saved package's record of what its storefront was built from (EDS-13f decision 2).

RepositoryRef.description: A GitHub repository by its coordinates.

owner.description: GitHub owner/organization of the patch repository

path.description: Path within repo to the patch family directory (contains code-patches.json)

lkgFile.description: Repo-relative path to the LKG file when this ledger tracks a non-default canonical (multi-canonical patches repos). Omitted = the default root `last-known-good`. Every current package entry (citisignal-b2b, b2b, bodea) tracks adobe-commerce/boilerplate-b2b-template and sets `lkgFile: "b2b/last-known-good"`; the root default is presently unused.

CodePatchSource.description:
CodePatchSource - External repository for code patches.

Sibling of  {@link  ContentPatchSource } . Code patches are file-level edits applied to a cloned storefront repo during create/reset, after reset-to-template and after block install. The engine knows no canonical file by name; everything comes from the external ledger fetched here.

Per ADR-006 D3 the canonical home is `skukla/eds-demo-patches` (the generalized successor to `eds-demo-content-patches`); a path of e.g. `citisignal` selects the patch family for a storefront.

StorefrontBoilerplate.description: What a storefront's code was built on (EDS-13f decision 1): the `name` and `version` of its `package.json`. Both Adobe Commerce canonicals call themselves `@adobe/aem-boilerplate-commerce`; the B2B line is 6.x, the B2C line 10.x.
